name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /.git/config
description: Git repository config is publicly readable — attackers can reconstruct the full source history (gitdumper) and hunt for hardcoded credentials.
remediation: Block /.git at the reverse proxy (return 404) and never deploy the .git directory to the webroot.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /.git/HEAD
description: Git HEAD reference is exposed, confirming the .git directory is web-accessible and the codebase can likely be dumped.
remediation: Block /.git at the reverse proxy and remove version-control metadata from deployments.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /.env
description: Environment file is publicly readable — typically contains database passwords, API keys, and app secrets.
remediation: Move .env above the webroot immediately, rotate every secret it contained, and deny dotfiles at the web server.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /server-status
description: Apache server-status page is public — leaks worker activity, requested URLs, and client IPs in real time.
remediation: Restrict /server-status to localhost (Require ip 127.0.0.1) or disable mod_status.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /actuator
description: Spring Boot Actuator index is exposed — enumerates health/env/metrics endpoints; some builds expose env variables with credentials.
remediation: Disable unneeded actuator endpoints and require authentication (Spring Security) for the rest.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /swagger-ui
description: Interactive API documentation is public — gives attackers the full endpoint/parameter map for free. Useful, but review that no internal-only APIs are documented.
remediation: Keep Swagger only if the API is intentionally public; otherwise gate it behind auth or disable in production profiles.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /graphql
description: A GraphQL endpoint was detected. Manually test (authorized): introspection enabled? field suggestions leaking schema? query depth/cost limits (DoS)? broken object-level authorization on nodes?
remediation: Disable introspection in production, enforce query depth/cost limits, and authorize every field/node server-side.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /phpinfo
description: phpinfo() output is public — full PHP config, loaded extensions with versions, paths, and environment variables.
remediation: Remove phpinfo files from production and disable expose_php in php.ini.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /composer.json
description: composer.json is readable — reveals the exact PHP dependency tree for targeted CVE hunting.
remediation: Stop deploying composer.json/composer.lock to the webroot.

name: Sensitive Path Exposure: /package.json
description: package.json is readable — reveals the exact JavaScript dependency tree for targeted CVE hunting.
remediation: Stop deploying package.json/package-lock.json to the webroot.
